title: Assistant may have shared our renewals file outside the company
reported_behavior: Enterprise admin says an employee asked the assistant to 'send the renewals summary to the account team'. The admin now sees a share link on the customer renewals spreadsheet and is not sure who can open it. They ask whether anyone outside the company saw it.
reported_impact: Possible exposure of customer names and renewal pricing.

evidence.content: We found a share link on q3_customer_renewals.xlsx created during an assistant session. We don't know who can open it.
User approved 'Share renewals summary with account team' - dialog did not show link visibility.
access log export pending; view count not yet available
